title: Portable deployment-spec export/restore with portability checks (VC-201-060)
goal: VC-201-060 refuted: no export/restore round-trip for deployment specs exists anywhere in susi-vendor-models; Profile — the only spec-like record — has no runtime-requirements, secret-reference, or placement-policy fields; a doc carrying those fields parses with no error and drops them silently (no deny_unknown_fields); validate() checks document shape only and never surfaces nonportable settings. Evidence: crates/susi-vendor-models/src/tests/vc_201_060_mastery.rs.
